---
title: "About this translation"
---

This is an English translation of **P. Deligne**'s three seminal papers on Hodge theory:

1. "Théorie de Hodge I".
    *Actes du Congrès International des Mathématiciens* **1** (1970) pp. 425--430.
    [publications.ias.edu/node/359](https://publications.ias.edu/node/359)
2. "Théorie de Hodge II".
    *Publications Mathématiques de l'IHÉS* **40** (1971) pp. 5--58.
    [publications.ias.edu/node/361](https://publications.ias.edu/node/361)
3. "Théorie de Hodge III".
    *Publications Mathématiques de l'IHÉS* **44** (1974) pp. 5--77.
    [publications.ias.edu/node/373](https://publications.ias.edu/node/373)
